system.description:
Learn two additional cantrips from your class spell list. Once per round, when you cast a cantrip, add your casting-stat modifier (minimum +1) to its damage or healing when it hits or the target fails its save. It does not stack with Agonising Blast.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.

rules.value: Cantrip Mastery: once per round add your casting-stat modifier (min +1) to a cantrip's damage or healing; not with Agonising Blast.
